messages:
maria-support: Heads-up — several customers started reporting P99 jumps after Verdant v1.2 onboarding in eu-west. p95 before = ~420ms, now ~1.2s; p99 spiking to ~3.5-4s for >32k token requests. Not universal, concentrated on long-context workloads.
kevin-sre: Copy. Any recent infra deploys or router changes?
maria-support: No infra deploys in the window, only model catalog swap (v1.1 -> v1.2) and tokenizer update (sentence-boundary merge enabled). Customers report slow tokenization + backend token boundary mismatches.
anne-ml: Looking at traces now. Initial sign: tokenizer is producing longer token sequences (more subwords) for some CJK-heavy inputs + sentence-split adding extra tokens. That increases KV cache pressure and triggers slowpath in runtime batching logic.
devon-sdk: Can you paste an example request we can repro with?
maria-support: Sure — here's a minimal repro (sanitized):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -d '{"model":"verdant-1.2", "input":"[long multi-paragraph document ~35k chars]", "max_tokens":512}'
```

kevin-sre: I ran that curl via canary. Timeline: tokenization 420ms, enqueue/kv-cache lookup 80ms, runtime slowpath (no continuous batching) 2.6s, total ~3.1s. Logs show repeated kvcache misses + large KV payloads.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary route for verdant-1.2 shows 12% p99 errors > 2s in eu-west.
anne-ml: Hypothesis: tokenizer v2 changed segmentation at sentence boundaries causing increased token count for these long docs; runtime kernel selection then falls back to safe path (no fused attention), degrading perf.
kevin-sre: Repro confirmed on a dedicated host with same model binary. Also noticed memory spikes when sequence > 30k tokens leading to GC pauses in the runtime shim.
devon-sdk: Quick mitigation options: 1) revert tokenizer sentence-boundary merge for verdant-1.2, 2) pin customers to verdant-1.1 until fix, 3) enable kvcache prewarm/force-prefix sampling for long-context canaries. Which one do we want now?
maria-support: Prioritize rollback for hosted customers with active incidents, and pin the catalog to 1.1 for new requests. I'll coordinate comms.
kevin-sre: I'll open infra rollback and a hotfix branch to ensure model runtime picks optimized kernel for long seqs. Also adding a guard to reject (>40k tokens) with 429 and guidance to chunk.
anne-ml: I'll run tokenizer diffs to find exact sentence-boundary rules causing the expansion and prepare a patch that preserves previous token counts for long inputs.
ops-bot: ticket-manager: Created INC-2026-438 (Verdant v1.2 long-context p99 regression). Linked oncall: @kevin-sre, @anne-ml, @maria-support.
devon-sdk: Can we add a quick server-side kludge to prefer quantized kernel when memory pressure high? Might buy time.
kevin-sre: Possibly, but risk of quality regression. We'll do canary tests. Rolling pin to 1.1 for affected customers now.
maria-support: Noted. I'll send customer update: rollback + ETA for root-cause + next steps. Will follow up when patch lands. :thumbsup:
kevin-sre: Follow-ups: add telemetry to track token counts pre/post tokenization, KV cache hit rates, and runtime kernel selection per request. Anne, please include a small eval harness that simulates >30k docs.
anne-ml: On it — will deliver repro harness and tokenizer patch by EOD.
kevin-sre: Closing thread once rollback is confirmed and customers acknowledged.
